entry.summary: Authoritative engineering definitions for DAMOS/A2L, 100% Virgin ORI, Bench GPT, TPROT, CVN, Virtual Read, SCR Inducement, OPF/GPF, Nm-to-IQ, LP-EGR, DSG Clamping, ZF 8HP & 24V ACM/MCM.

entry.title: What is 100% Virgin Original ECU File (.ORI)? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: A 100% virgin original ECU file is an unmodified factory binary readout extracted directly from an engine or transmission control unit (or downloaded via genuine OEM Virtual Read) with all factory maps, diagnostic fault classes, torque monitors, and checksum blocks completely intact.

entry.title: What is DAMOS, ASAP2 (.A2L) & WinOLS (.OLS) Map Definitions? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: DAMOS and ASAP2 (.A2L) files are official OEM engineering description files created by ECU manufacturers (Bosch, Continental, Delphi, Denso, Marelli) that define exact hexadecimal memory addresses, data types, conversion factors, units, and axes for every calibration parameter inside a specific ECU software build.

entry.title: What is Bench Service Mode (GPT1 / GPT2) ECU Reading? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: Bench Service Mode (using General Purpose Timer signals GPT1 and GPT2 alongside CAN High/Low and switched +12V/24V power) is a non-invasive manufacturer factory protocol that reads and writes full internal Microcontroller Flash and EEPROM directly through the external ECU pins without opening the metal housing.

entry.title: What is TPROT (Tuning Protection) & RSA Signature Verification? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: TPROT (Tuning Protection) is a cryptographic bootloader security layer introduced by Bosch on Tricore MEDC17 and SPC58/Aurix MD1/MG1 ECUs that verifies RSA digital signatures before permitting calibration flashing over the vehicle OBD-II port.

entry.title: What is CVN (Calibration Verification Number) & Block Checksums? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: A Calibration Verification Number (CVN) is a standardized OBD-II Mode $09 hexadecimal hash computed by the ECU across its active calibration memory blocks so inspection stations and OEM diagnostic tools can verify software integrity.

entry.title: What is Virtual Read (VR) in Master ECU Programmers? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: A Virtual Read (VR) occurs when an ECU blocks direct OBD memory readout, so the hardware programmer reads the ECU Software Identification (SW/CAL-ID) over OBD and downloads the matching 100% unmodified factory binary from the tool manufacturer’s cloud server.

entry.title: What is SCR (Selective Catalytic Reduction) & AdBlue / DEF Dosing? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) is an active diesel aftertreatment subsystem that injects automotive-grade 32.5% urea solution (AdBlue / DEF) upstream of a catalyst to convert nitrogen oxides (NOx) into nitrogen and water vapor, monitored by upstream/downstream NOx sensors and inducement counters.

entry.title: What is AdBlue "No Start in XXX km" Inducement Lock? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: The AdBlue start-inducement counter is a legislative Euro 6 / Tier 4F state machine stored across ECU Flash and EEPROM/DCU memory that restricts engine restarting once remaining range reaches 0 km due to reagent quality, heater, pump, or NOx sensor faults.

entry.title: What is DPF (Diesel Particulate Filter) Soot & Ash Mass Model? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: The Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF / FAP) soot and ash model is a mathematical simulation inside the diesel ECU combining differential exhaust pressure (hPa), volumetric exhaust flow, and EGT sensors to schedule post-injection active regenerations.

entry.title: What is OPF / GPF (Otto / Gasoline Particulate Filter)? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: An Otto Particulate Filter (OPF / GPF) is a ceramic exhaust substrate fitted to Euro 6d direct-injection turbo-petrol engines (such as VAG TSI, BMW B48/B58/S58, AMG M177/M139, and Audi RS TFSI) monitored via differential exhaust backpressure sensors.

entry.title: What is High-Pressure (HP-EGR) vs Low-Pressure (LP-EGR) Loops? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: High-Pressure EGR routes exhaust gas directly from the exhaust manifold into the intake manifold, whereas Euro 6 Low-Pressure EGR draws clean, cooled exhaust gas downstream of the DPF back into the turbocharger compressor inlet.

entry.title: What is Cerine / Eolys Fuel-Borne Catalyst Additive (PSA FAP)? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: Cerine (Eolys) is an iron/cerium organometallic fuel additive injected into the diesel tank on Peugeot, Citroën, DS, Ford, Volvo, and Mazda HDi/BlueHDi vehicles by a multiplexed additive pump to lower soot combustion temperature from 600°C to 450°C.

entry.title: What is Intake Swirl Flaps & Tumble Generator Valves (P2015)? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: Intake swirl flaps (and petrol tumble generator valves) are electronically actuated butterflies inside individual intake manifold runners that partially close at low RPM to increase charge-air turbulence and combustion mixing.

entry.title: What is Torque-to-Injection-Quantity (Nm-to-IQ) Conversion Map? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: The Torque-to-IQ map is the core physical translation table in torque-modeled diesel ECUs (Bosch EDC16, EDC17, MD1, Delphi DCM, Continental SID) converting requested internal crankshaft torque (Nm) into fuel mass (mg/stroke) across engine RPM.

entry.title: What is Driver Wish (Accelerator Pedal-to-Torque) Map? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: The Driver Wish map translates accelerator pedal position (0–100%) and engine speed (RPM) into a driver torque request (Nm or % load), often featuring separate tables for Eco, Comfort, Sport, Reverse, and Low-Range 4WD.

entry.title: What is Diesel Smoke Limiter (MAF vs MAP Lambda Limitation)? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: A diesel Smoke Limiter restricts maximum injected fuel quantity (mg/stroke) based on measured Mass Air Flow (MAF) or calculated Manifold Boost Pressure (MAP) to maintain a clean stoichiometric excess-air ratio (Lambda ≥ 1.15–1.22) and prevent black soot.

entry.title: What is SOI (Start of Injection) Crankshaft Angle Maps? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: Start of Injection (SOI) maps specify the exact crankshaft angle in degrees Before Top Dead Center (°BTDC) at which the common-rail piezo or solenoid injector begins its main injection event as a function of RPM, IQ, and coolant temperature.

entry.title: What is Injector Duration ( energizing Time in µs) Calibration? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: Injector Duration tables define the exact microsecond (µs) energizing pulse width required to deliver a target fuel quantity (mg/stroke) at a given Common-Rail Fuel Pressure (bar), derived directly from Bosch/Delphi hydraulic bench flow curves.

entry.title: What is VNT / VGT Variable Nozzle Turbocharger Duty & Setpoint? — ECU Calibration Engineering Definition | DaVinci Deluxe Cloud Edition
entry.summary: Variable Nozzle Turbine (VNT / VGT) control uses vacuum or electronic PWM REA actuators to adjust turbine inlet vane angles—closing vanes at low RPM for fast spool and opening them at high exhaust flow to regulate boost and backpressure (EMP).
